To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Internet architecture is not well suited to support wireless Internet access, since the link layer is not designed for wireless links; (2) wireless links can be enhanced to support the performance needs of diverse applications, but different enhancement schemes work best for each type of application; and (3) the Internet architecture can be modified to support multiple link layer enhancement schemes simultaneously.
(a) the performance of TCP and UDP applications over wireless links can be improved significantly using link layer enhancements and that (b) these improvements are application dependent.
link layer mechanisms can be used to improve Internet application performance, and that different applications require different mechanisms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a flexible link layer architecture that can be used by a broad range of Internet applications.
improving the Internet's ability to deliver high quality services over wireless links.
developing a link layer architecture that provides a flexible and efficient framework to enhance the performance of diverse Internet applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the multi-service link layer is an excellent approach for improving application performance over wireless Internet links.
the Internet needs more than just one link layer mechanism.
we have developed a multi-service architecture that simultaneously enhances a broad class of applications, and that this architecture is readily embeddable into the Internet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Internet is a complex system, and the performance of an application depends not only on the application itself and the network, but also on the interaction between the two.
the Internet is a multi-service environment.
the Internet is an excellent example of the principle that the best solution is to have a flexible architecture that supports a variety of solutions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to improve the performance of diverse Internet applications over wireless links without global modifications.
a multi-service approach is necessary to achieve the best overall performance.
the Internet is a complex system, and that simple solutions may be insufficient to solve the problems that arise.
